system.flavor: Rifle-propelled incendiary grenade. Load into a Grenade Launcher.
system.notes:
THE BOOK, TEXT-LAYER VERIFIED 2026-08-27 (CP2020 Core, text layer only).

The launcher fires the ORDINARY grenade types. Core p.111, verbatim: "All grenade types are available in hand or rifle-propelled versions, and are described in the Area Effect Weapons & Grenade Table, pg. 89." Launched range, same page: "...or launched to a range of 225 meters."

Core p.64 HEAVY WEAPONS, the Grenade entry, verbatim: "Types include Fragmentation (7D6), Incendiary (4D6 for 3 turns), Stun (-5 to Stun), Dazzle (Blind for 4 turns), Sonic (deafened 4 turns), Gas (see FNFF Gas Table)." The base pack's thrown Incendiary Grenade carries the same 4d6 with the flavor line "Damage applies over 3 rounds".

HOW THE THREE TURNS ARE MODELLED: the hit itself is 4D6 and the burn field carries TWO more turns, so the round deals 4D6 on three turns in all - the printed figure, FLAT, exactly as p.64 states it. The split (initial + 2) is a reading; the book prints only "4D6 for 3 turns" and does not say how the total is distributed, but it prints no decay either, so none is applied.

THE FLAT MARKER, AND WHAT IT OPTS OUT OF (user ruling 2026-08-28: "it should match the book"): the module's fire flow normally HALVES the burn each turn after the first (damage-hooks fire DOT, mult /2). That decay is the module's own generalization of the p.110 FLAMETHROWER ladder ("2D10 the 1st turn, 1D10 and 1D6 the following two turns") - the only diminishing burn the book actually prints - and it remains the default for every other burning load, including the Armor-Piercing Incendiary. This round sets dotFlat, which holds the tick's multiplier at 1 for every turn it lasts, so what is dealt is 4D6, 4D6, 4D6. The fields are otherwise exactly the ones that load uses - dotEnabled / dotTurns / dotDamageFormula / dotType "fire" - so the burn still routes through the one flow.

INFERRED, NOT PRINTED: the per-round COST. The HEAVY WEAPONS price column of the p.61-62 weapons table has NO TEXT LAYER in the reference PDF and image-only tables are not read here, so this round mirrors the base pack's thrown Incendiary Grenade instead - 30eb, 0.5 kg. The same 30eb is written onto boxSize 1 / boxCost 30 so the ammo sheet's own restock control charges for a round rather than handing one out free: "Grenade" is not a registered caliber, and an unregistered caliber falls to the "none" cost class (box 1, price 0). Blast radius is left at 0 on purpose, so the module's single book-sourced grenade area (5 m, CP2020 p.99 AREA EFFECT TABLE) answers for it.
